title: Transportation Design Intern
note: Truck design studio; for transportation design students or recent grads, closes Nov 11.

facts.summary: Truck design intern in DTNA's Design Center in Portland.
facts.duties: Research, mood boards, personas, ideation sketches, digital renderings, concept-model support, and weekly critiques.
facts.requirements: Transportation design student, strong sketching and rendering, Photoshop and Alias. VRED and Unreal are a plus.
facts.apply: Apply through DTNA Workday with a PDF portfolio or link. The posting ends 2026-11-11.
